LCutoffRegime.logarithmic_cutoff_length (w Lambda Lambda' Lambda'' : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) (hL : 0 < Lambda)
  (hL' : 0 < Lambda') (hL'' : 0 < Lambda'') :
  Real.log Lambda - Real.log (max (w / Lambda') (1 / Lambda'')) =
    Real.log (Lambda * Lambda') - Real.log w - LCutoffRegime.lowerCutoffBoundary w Lambda' Lambda''
